research.title: Tracing Provenance and Detecting Tampering with Complementary LLM Watermarks
research.summary: arXiv:2608.12713v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Watermarking LLM-generated text is an important task for tracing its provenance. Existing LLM watermarks preserve provenance under editing, but this same robustness allows an adversary to alter critical content while retaining attribution, a vulnerability known as piggyback spoofing. We introduce an innovative watermark that jointly provides provenance and tamper evidence. It co-embeds a robust signal and a fragile signal into each generated token.
